scope: S08 API/Service Account Settings desktop acceptance against the frozen S08 contract and implemented backend (descriptor settings.api-service-account)

cases.name: Four-family panel renders with compiled defaults
cases.expectation: token lifecycle / machine scope / rate limit / audit-invocation policies and 编译默认值 projection render

cases.name: Empty validation, history, account and invocation views
cases.expectation: 尚未验证当前草稿 / 尚无发布历史 shown; safe account and invocation views render

cases.name: Consumer readiness matrix (5 ready + 1 future obligation)
cases.expectation: matrix renders implemented_ready consumers and the ERP Product API machine future obligation

cases.name: Unknown role key validation blocker
cases.expectation: server rejects ROGUE_ROLE with S08_ROLE_UNKNOWN; draft invalid

cases.name: Exact-generation readiness (5 ready / 1 future obligation)
cases.expectation: degraded with exactly 5 implemented_ready at exact generation and erp-product-api-machine future_obligation

cases.name: Read-only impact preview
cases.expectation: aggregate policy only; zero business/provider/job effects; no plaintext/tokenHash material

cases.name: Token create one-time reveal
cases.expectation: plaintext revealed exactly once; second read and list never return plaintext

cases.name: Rotate overlap + idempotent replay no plaintext
cases.expectation: predecessor rotated with narrowed expiry; replay returns plaintextAvailable=false and no second token

cases.name: Revoke
cases.expectation: token revoked with revokedAt; never restored
